lede: Grand Theft Auto VI has taken over the web, landing on four separate feeds at the same time. Its Wikipedia page drew 750,227 views, a MrBeast Gaming video titled I Survived 100 Hours In GTA 6 pulled 13,897,138 views on YouTube, the shitpost Grand task auto six climbed to 705 upvotes on Lemmy, and the franchise still holds two spots on Steam top sellers. The quieter story sits one layer down: a week after Jensen Huang exit from Nvidia, prediction markets give barely a one percent chance he rejoins by November 30, and the coverage has moved on to who replaces him.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
throughlines.gist: The year biggest game is everywhere at once: top of Wikipedia, all over YouTube, a hit post on Lemmy, and a fixture on Steam.

throughlines.title: Will Jensen Huang rejoin NVIDIA by November 30, 2026?
throughlines.gist: After Huang departure, Nvidia succession is live on the AI news wire while traders put barely a one percent chance on his return this month.
